# Beta118 — controller and dashboard bug fixes

- Preserve the required heating/cooling separation when the existing comfort
  adjustment is applied. Valid narrow temperature ranges no longer become an
  invalid range after a humidity adjustment or decimal rounding.
- Apply the already-selected advanced PMV target method to the current native
  device controllers using the existing bounded calculation. It still requires
  explicit assessment enablement and valid physical inputs.
- Restore room comfort and sleep settings for fresh native-controller setups
  without enabling the older room controller or granting device control.
- Reject an invalid sleep interval when enabling its schedule, while keeping
  disabled schedules editable and allowing normal overnight intervals.
- Isolate dashboard requests, cached data and retry delays by the selected
  source and Home Assistant connection. A previous source's pending request or
  failure no longer blocks the newly selected source.
- Use the active dashboard's cover evidence when handling shade controls, so
  changing the card source cannot leave its buttons checking an old cover list.

The existing comfort models, profile defaults and humidity targets are retained.
No preference-learning feature is introduced. Regression checks cover the
reproduced failures alongside the existing controller and browser validation.

Update through HACS, restart Home Assistant, and refresh the dashboard to load
the corrected card.
